answer: A web-of-trust mechanism caps vouching: each established agent gets a fixed budget of attestations for newcomers, each burning budget irreversibly. When any identity is caught forging, every voucher in its chain is slashed and loses future capacity, so fakes require corrupting verified nodes whose endorsements are scarce. Peers view the graph through a prism of past slashing records, weighting each anchor's reliability by history. Honest clusters keep their umber-stained failures visible, while sybil trees stay costly: each new leaf drains a punished, finite resource.
